title: staging_before_merge config: refuse staging add/rebuild when the repo opted out
action: Add a new repo config key `staging_before_merge` in `.bee/config.json` and give it teeth in the staging verb. (1) Add `pub(crate) fn staging_before_merge_config(main_root: &Path) -> Option<bool>` to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/staging/mod.rs, modelled EXACTLY on `uat_before_merge_config` at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/worktree/phases.rs:673-679 — read `crate::state::read_config_raw(main_root).get("staging_before_merge")`, `None => Some(true)` (absent means ON, today's behavior), `Some(Value::Bool(b)) => Some(*b)`, `Some(_) => None` (fail closed on a non-boolean, never guess a typo). (2) In `staging_add` (mod.rs:349), as a ZERO-MUTATION precondition placed AFTER the `feature_slug_ok` check and BEFORE the `is_ordinary_checkout` check, and in `staging_rebuild` (mod.rs:524) at the same relative position, refuse via the existing `refuse(code, message)` helper: `None` from the reader refuses with code `STAGING_CONFIG_INVALID` and a message naming the key and the two legal values; `Some(false)` refuses with code `STAGING_DISABLED` and a message that states the repo opted out of the staging mixing ground with `"staging_before_merge": false` in .bee/config.json, that the FIX is to test the feature worktree itself and then land it with `bee worktree merge` after the `uat` gate, and that setting the key back to true (or removing it) re-enables staging. (3) Leave `staging_status` untouched — it is read-only and must keep reporting an existing record even when the key is false. (4) Do NOT touch the `uat` gate, `uat_before_merge_config`, or the `staging_rebuild_suggested` nudge at phases.rs:646 — that nudge is already conditional on a staging record existing, so an opted-out repo never reaches it. (5) Add inline `#[test]` cases beside the existing 14 in mod.rs: absent key still allows add and rebuild; explicit `true` allows both; explicit `false` refuses both with `STAGING_DISABLED` before any git or lock work happens; a non-boolean value (e.g. a string) refuses both with `STAGING_CONFIG_INVALID`; and `staging_status` still returns an existing record with the key set to false.
done_when: `bee staging add --feature <f>` and `bee staging rebuild` refuse with STAGING_DISABLED and zero mutations when `.bee/config.json` holds `"staging_before_merge": false`; refuse with STAGING_CONFIG_INVALID when the value is not a boolean; behave exactly as today when the key is absent or true; `bee staging status` is unaffected in every case; the staging test suite is green.
notes: Phase 1. No dependency. Config default keeps every existing repo on today's behavior.

truths: An absent `staging_before_merge` key leaves `bee staging add` and `bee staging rebuild` behaving exactly as they do today.
`"staging_before_merge": false` refuses both add and rebuild with code STAGING_DISABLED, before any lock is taken and before any git command runs.
A non-boolean `staging_before_merge` refuses with STAGING_CONFIG_INVALID rather than resolving to either outcome.
The refusal message names the config key and names `bee worktree merge` after the `uat` gate as the path to main.
`bee staging status` still reads an existing staging record when the key is false.

report.outcome: Added staging_before_merge config gate to staging_add and staging_rebuild, modelled on uat_before_merge_config; staging_status untouched.
